deals.name: GIGABYTE Eagle GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16GB OC
deals.why: One of the more approachable partner 5070 Ti cards right now, with a clear $71 cut on Newegg. Same 16GB GDDR7 class as pricier boards—strong 1440p/4K value if you can skip the premium coolers.

deals.name: MSI Ventus GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16GB OC
deals.why: Matches the current street floor for many 5070 Ti cards at Newegg. Triple-fan Ventus cooler, 16GB GDDR7, and DLSS 4—among the better-priced ways into a popular Blackwell card today.

deals.name: GIGABYTE MO32U24 31.5" 4K 240Hz QD-OLED
deals.why: 20% off list on Amazon for a current-gen 4K 240Hz QD-OLED. HDMI 2.1, FreeSync Premium Pro / G-SYNC Compatible, and a 3-year burn-in warranty—rare discount on a new panel, not clearance of last year’s model.

deals.name: LG C6 65" OLED evo AI 4K TV (2026)
deals.why: About $1,100 off MSRP at Best Buy. Four HDMI 2.1 ports, up to 165Hz from a PC, VRR, and Dolby Vision—still one of the strongest mid-range gaming OLEDs you can buy this year.

deals.name: LG C6 55" OLED evo AI 4K TV (2026)
deals.why: $500 off on LG’s own store (and matching big-box pricing). Same Alpha 11 Gen3 brain and gaming feature set as the 65-inch in a desk-friendlier size for consoles or a living-room PC.

deals.name: LG B6E 55" OLED AI 4K TV (2026)
deals.why: $500 off at Best Buy for a 2026 OLED with 4K 120Hz gaming, Dolby Vision, and webOS. Skips a few C6 processing niceties, but the panel deal is hard to beat if you want OLED without the C-series premium.

deals.name: LG 91A 65" QNED evo AI Mini-LED 4K TV
deals.why: Roughly half off list at Best Buy. Mini-LED brightness without OLED burn-in worry—solid big-screen pick for bright rooms and mixed gaming/movie use.

deals.name: Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus
deals.why: Member pricing drops this 24-core Arrow Lake chip to $199.99 at Micro Center (pickup). Strong productivity CPU that still games well—especially with Micro Center’s nearby motherboard + RAM bundles.

deals.name: MSI MAG A850GL PCIE5 850W Gold Modular PSU
deals.why: ATX 3.1 / native 12V-2x6 for modern GPUs, fully modular, and $20 off at Newegg. Sensible 850W headroom for a 5070 Ti-class build without overspending on the PSU.

deals.name: Logitech G305 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Mouse
deals.why: 40% off list on Amazon. Hero sensor, 1 ms LIGHTSPEED, and ~250-hour AA battery—still one of the best cheap wireless gaming mice you can buy.

deals.name: SteelSeries Apex 3 TKL Gaming Keyboard
deals.why: Quiet Whisper switches, tenkeyless desk space, and water resistance at a clearance-friendly $35. Easy daily-driver keyboard when you don’t need hall-effect premium pricing.

deals.name: LG C6H 77" OLED evo AI 4K TV (2026)
deals.why: $1,000 off on LG.com for the brighter Hyper Radiant C6H panel in a true living-room size. Same gaming ports and 165Hz PC mode as the C6, with extra brightness for daytime viewing.
